value.full: Welcome to this well kept home featuring a bright entry, hallway and living area with lots of natural light, hardwood, tile and vinyl flooring. The kitchen includes a dishwasher, gas stove, refrigerator and clean dark wood cabinets. The bathroom offers a bathtub, renovated finishes, ceiling fan and radiator heat. Enjoy a balcony/patio, a well kept porch and landscaped front yard. An older staircase showcases original woodwork, and the interior is freshly painted with glossy floors, though paint debris remains on the floor.
value.short: Bright home with hardwood, tile, vinyl floors, dishwasher, gas stove, bathtub, balcony, porch, landscaped yard, original woodwork staircase, freshly painted interior.
